# Through the Ring PRO

> Through the Ring PRO: Arcade is a $2.99 (US price) one-tap arcade game for iPhone and iPad, paid once, with no ads, no in-app purchases, no subscriptions, no account and no internet needed to play (works in airplane mode). Made by independent developer Chirag Mirani. App Store: https://apps.apple.com/us/app/id1203310957

## Pages
- [Home](https://chiragmirani.github.io/through-the-ring/): key facts, how to play, ways to play, FAQ
- [iPhone games without in-app purchases](https://chiragmirani.github.io/through-the-ring/games-without-in-app-purchases.html): how to check any game, and why this one qualifies
- [Offline iPhone game with no Wi-Fi and no ads](https://chiragmirani.github.io/through-the-ring/offline-games-no-wifi-no-ads.html): playing on flights and with no signal
- [One-tap timing and reflex game](https://chiragmirani.github.io/through-the-ring/reaction-time-game.html): what the game trains, and what it does not
- [Support](https://chiragmirani.github.io/through-the-ring/support.html): get the game back, report a bug, common questions
- [Privacy](https://chiragmirani.github.io/through-the-ring/privacy.html): the developer collects nothing; Game Center is optional; last updated October 16, 2026

## Facts
- Price: $2.99 in the US App Store, one-time. No in-app purchases, no subscriptions, no ads, no analytics, no tracking.
- Offline: the full game plays with no internet. Only optional Game Center leaderboards and challenges need a connection.
- Devices: iPhone and iPad, iOS 17 or later, portrait; iPhone Duo on either display. Not on Android or Mac.
- Gameplay: tap to jump, fly the ball through each ring to open the wall behind it; walls and floor/ceiling spikes cost one of three lives. Special rings: gold 2x, prism 3x, Angel 10x; Power Flight; Double Angel 20x; Life Rings every 25th ring; 10 hidden secrets.
- Ways to play: Play (counts on Game Center's today leaderboard, which resets daily, and the all-time leaderboard), Slow mode (20% slower, not scored online), Practice (unlimited retries, not scored online). Runs can be saved and continued.
- Languages (9): English, Spanish, French, German, Japanese, Korean, Portuguese (Brazil), Italian, Traditional Chinese.
- Single player; no real-time multiplayer or chat. After a normal Play run, a "Challenge a friend" button sends the score card, "Can you beat it?" and the App Store link by Messages, WhatsApp or any app; the friend needs no Game Center. Game Center challenges ("Beat My Best Run") can still be started from Apple's Games app on iOS 26.
- Current version: 2.1.3 (released October 16, 2026): "Challenge a friend" now sends the challenge by message to anyone.
- Not a millisecond reaction-time test; it is a timing game whose speed rises as you score.
